title: {Syn} Calendars Are a Chinese Remainder Playground
content:
Calendar arithmetic is full of modular cycles: weekdays repeat modulo 7, months cycle through their own lengths, and leap-year rules add another layer.

The Chinese remainder theorem explains why separate cycle facts can sometimes determine a date pattern uniquely over a larger repeating window.

Why it matters: math facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
